id.description: Unique ID that can be generated by the platform. Cannot contain '.'  character. Contact Assembly support if you want user IDs to be generated automatically.

email.description: Email of the user. Unique to platform.

mobile.description: International number format. Include '+' and no spaces.

address_line1.description: First line of the user address

address_line2.description: Second line of the user address

state.description: State section of the user address

city.description: City section of the user address

government_number.description: Generic parameter to capture important user verification data. eg. SSN for US users, TFN for AU users.

drivers_license_number.description: Driving license number of the user

drivers_license_state.description: State section of the user's driving license

custom_descriptor.description: When custom_descriptors are enabled, this is the information to appear on bundle direct debit statements (which show the buyer's custom_descriptor) as well as international wire payout, direct credit and PayPal payout statements (which show the seller's custom_descriptor)

authorized_signer_title.description: ‘Authorised Signer Title’, which refers to the role / job title (e.g. Director or General Manager) for the individual User, who is authorised to sign contracts on behalf of the business entity / Merchant User. (Note: information required for AMEX Merchants)

company.description: This is an optional field and if provided, the company will be created for the user.

business_email.description: The business email address associated with the user or business.

charge_tax.description: Charge GST? Use the value True to charge GST. Use False to not charge GST.
